svg.text: AI-Based Movie Booking System — UML Class Diagram
Core domain model • booking workflow • transactional entities • AI services
BookingStatus: PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, COMPLETED
SeatStatus: AVAILABLE, SELECTED, LOCKED, BOOKED, BLOCKED
MovieStatus: UPCOMING, NOW_SHOWING, COMING_SOON, COMPLETED, INACTIVE
Each Recommendation is associated with one User and one Movie.
• ShowSeat maintains show-specific seat availability and prevents double booking.
• Booking becomes CONFIRMED only after successful payment; failed/expired payments release locks.
• Seat locks expire automatically; overlapping shows on the same screen are prohibited.
• AI recommendations exclude unavailable, inactive, and past movies; the chatbot enforces authorization.
AI services access domain data through secured application services and APIs.
